austin.summary: Austin, you drafted 5th in the snake and somehow walked off with the whole board. Four for four still in the game, 8 counted points, tied for rank 1 of 5 — that is how you start a season. Episode 1 handed you +4, your Draft GPA sits at 3.75, and Eric at pick #16 looks like the steal of the entire draft. 106 points still on the table. Keep that buff on.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Nobody's carrying it alone — Linnea, Jenna, Carter, and Eric each have 2 pts and each rank 1 of 21, a perfectly balanced four-headed roster.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Three of your four — Linnea, Carter, and Eric — are stacked on Savu, so one rough tribal swing hits most of your team at once, and Linnea's B grade is the softest mark on the sheet.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: Jenna, your lone Toka and your only A-grade outsider from the Savu bloc, is the wedding photographer who's been planning this since she was seven — watch what that strategist does away from the pack.

kylie.summary: Kylie, you took the first punch of this season — Aaliyah went home Episode 1, you wear the First Blood badge, and you sit 5 of 5 with 6 counted points. But look closer: the leader has 8. Eight! And 82 points are still on the table with 3 of 4 of your people still breathing. A 3 draft GPA, three castaways tied at rank 1 of 21 — this is not a hole, it's a running start.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Cristian, Alexis and Kilby are locked together at 2 pts apiece, each ranked 1 of 21 with an A grade — three engines, no passengers.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Aaliyah at pick #3 was the reach that stung, going out 1st in Ep 1 with 0 pts and a rank of 21 of 21.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: Kilby at pick #18 is your steal of the draft — a Survivor superfan on Toka thinking three steps ahead, and he's the storyline I'd keep my eyes glued to.

tami.summary: Tami, you had the first pick and you built a full house — all 5 of 5 still in the game, and you're sitting at rank 1 (tied) of 5 with 8 counted points. Prosecutor, baseball exec, gate agent, OB/GYN resident, sociology professor: every chair at this table is occupied. Ep 1 gave you your best week at +4, your draft GPA sits at 3.6, and your roster already owns the Idol Whisperer badge. That's a start.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Sharonda, your leftover at pick #21, is the steal of the draft and sits at 2 pts, rank 1 of 21 — right alongside every other name you drafted.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Angelica "Jelly" was your very first pick and she's the only C on an otherwise straight-A board, so that top slot hasn't separated itself yet.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: With 2 idols and advantages already found across your roster and 106 points still on the table, watch whether your Toka trio keeps feeding that Idol Whisperer badge.

taylor.summary: Taylor, you drafted second and built a roster with grit: a crisis manager, a hustler, a pro wrestler. You sit rank 4 of 5 with 7 counted points, but the leader has 8 and there are 82 points still on the table — that's nothing, that's a stumble, not a fall. Your draft GPA is 2.5 with few eliminations so far, best week Ep 1 (+4), worst week Ep 2 (+3). You're in contention.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Brady Booker, your pick #19 steal, sits at 2 pts and ranks 1 of 21 — and so do Kristin and Ori, giving you three players tied at the very top.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Ana Sani was the reach at pick #12 and went out 2nd in Ep 2, finishing with 1 pts and rank 20 of 21, leaving you 3 of 4 still in the game.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: Whether your Savu pair of Kristin and Ori can hold that top ranking while Brady works Toka from the other side of the map.

tim.summary: Tim, you drafted fourth and walked out with the entire Toka tribe — Lewis, Maggie, Devin and Thien An, all four still in the game, each sitting at 2 pts, rank 1 of 21. That's 8 counted points, a share of first place, and a 3.75 draft GPA this early. Episode 1 handed you a tidy +4. With 106 points still on the table, you are right in the thick of this thing.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Nobody's carrying it alone — Lewis, Maggie, Devin and Thien An are all tied at 2 pts and all ranked 1 of 21, with Thien An at pick #17 the clear steal of your draft.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Every name on your roster wears the same buff — Toka, top to bottom — so your fortunes rise and fall with one tribe, and Lewis is the lone B grade in an otherwise straight-A group.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: Watch whether the Toka chemistry holds — a cheeky farmer, a joyful farmer, a playful actor and an empathetic med student — because 106 points are still on the table and the leader has 8.
